lede: Thanksgiving lands square in the middle of this week, and the valley is leaning into it — the Turkey Trot runs Thursday morning, Alloy Kitchen is hosting an Outlaw Thanksgiving, and Will Ski 4 Food kicks off the holiday weekend on the mountain Saturday and Sunday. On the government side, the Open Space Commission and the Board of County Commissioners both have meetings on the books, but none of the agendas have been posted yet, so there's nothing to dig into this week.
